teaser.en: Cotton once earned cash on Kwale farms, and its wild cousin still grows as a liana in the coastal forest.
teaser.sw: Zamani pamba iliwaletea wakulima wa Kwale pesa, na binamu yake wa porini bado hukua kama mtambaa msituni pwani.
teaser.dg: Kare pamba kala inalavya pesa kpwenye minda ya Kwale, na nduguye wa tsaka bado inamera dza mmea unaokpwera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani.

summary.en: Cotton is a shrub grown for the white fibre that bursts from its bolls. On the south coast it was a minor cash crop, grown for fibre and income.
summary.sw: Pamba ni kichaka kinachopandwa kwa ajili ya nyuzi nyeupe zinazopasuka kutoka kwenye matumba yake. Pwani ya kusini lilikuwa zao dogo la biashara, lililopandwa kwa nyuzi na kipato.
summary.dg: Pamba ni muhi mdide unaophandwa kpwa sababu ya nyuzi nyereru zinazotuluka kula makakayage. Pwani ya kusini kala ni mmea mdide wa biashara, unaophandwa kpwa nyuzi na kpwa pesa.

about.en:
Cotton is a bushy shrub with broad, lobed leaves and large, cup-shaped flowers, cream or pale yellow when they open and turning pink as they fade, as in other members of the mallow family.

Each flower is followed by a rounded capsule, the boll, which splits open when ripe to show the seeds wrapped in soft white fibre.
about.sw:
Pamba ni kichaka chenye matawi mengi, majani mapana yenye mapengo, na maua makubwa yenye umbo la kikombe, ya rangi ya krimu au manjano hafifu yanapochanua na yanayogeuka waridi yanaponyauka, kama ilivyo kwa mimea mingine ya familia ya bamia na mlenda (*mallow*).

Kila ua hufuatwa na tumba la mviringo, ambalo hupasuka likishaiva na kuonyesha mbegu zilizofunikwa kwa nyuzi laini nyeupe.
about.dg:
Pamba ni muhi mdide wenye mapanda manji, makodza mapana genye mala, na maruwa makulu ga umbo ra chikombe. Maruwa gachivugulika ni ga rangi ya maziya au ya manjano ngushu-ngushu, na gachinyala ganagaluka kukala ga rangi ya pinki, dza mimea yanjina ya jamii ya *mallow*.

Chila ruwa richimala, kunamera kakaya ra mviringo, ambaro rinaahuka richiivwa na kuonyesa tembe zirizofwinikpwa ni nyuzi nyereru laini.

where.en: Cotton has been grown on farms in Kwale County as a minor cash crop, mostly in the past. Today it is far less common than cashew, coconut or sesame.
where.sw: Pamba imekuwa ikipandwa kwenye mashamba katika Kaunti ya Kwale kama zao dogo la biashara, hasa zamani. Leo si ya kawaida kama mkorosho, mnazi au ufuta.
where.dg: Pamba ikaphandwa kpwenye minda ya Kaunti ya Kwale dza mmea mdide wa biashara, zaidi kare. Sambi taiphahikana sana dza ngorosho, minazi au ufuha.

uses.en: Cotton is grown for its fibre, which is spun into thread and woven into cloth, and for the cash income it brings to farmers who sell the harvest.
uses.sw: Pamba hupandwa kwa nyuzi zake, ambazo husokotwa kuwa uzi na kufumwa kuwa kitambaa, na kwa kipato inachowaletea wakulima wanaouza mavuno.
uses.dg: Pamba inaphandwa kpwa nyuzize, ambazo nkusokotwa kuhenda uzi na nkusukwa kuhenda nguwo, na kpwa pesa inazoreha kpwa akurima anaoguza mavuno.

names.en: In Digo, cotton is *pamba*, the same word as in Swahili; the Mgombato dictionary records it in passing. In English it is cotton, and botanists know the cultivated cottons as species of *Gossypium*.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo, pamba ni *pamba*, neno lile lile la Kiswahili; kamusi ya Mgombato inalitaja kwa kupita. Kwa Kiingereza ni *cotton*, na wataalamu wa mimea huzijua pamba zinazolimwa kama spishi za *Gossypium*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo, pamba ni *pamba*, neno sawa na ra Chiswahili; Mgombato unarilavya tu kpwa kutsupa. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *cotton*, na kpwa chisayansi pamba zinazophandwa ni aina za *Gossypium*.

reason.en: Wild cotton, a liana relative of the coastal forest
reason.sw: Pamba-mwitu, mtambaa wa jamii yake wa misitu ya pwani
reason.dg: Pamba ya tsaka, mmea unaokpwera wa matsaka ga pwani

reason.en: Kapok, another plant grown for fibre
reason.sw: Msufi, mmea mwingine unaopandwa kwa nyuzi
reason.dg: Msufi, mmea wanjina unaophandwa kpwa nyuzi

reason.sw: Ufuta, zao lingine la biashara la mashamba makavu
reason.dg: Ufuha, mmea wanjina wa biashara wa minda mikavu

reason.sw: Tumbaku, zao lingine dogo la biashara
reason.dg: Tumbaku, mmea wanjina mdide wa biashara

definition.en: The woolly fruit of cotton, both planted cotton and the wild pamba mwitu. Probably borrowed from Persian through Swahili.
definition.sw: Tunda lenye nyuzi kama sufu la pamba, ya kupandwa na ile ya porini, pamba mwitu. Huenda lilikopwa kutoka Kiajemi kupitia Kiswahili.
definition.dg: Tunda ra pamba renye nyuzi-nyuzi, kpwa pamba inayophandwa na kpwa *pamba mwitu* ya tsaka. Pengine rikalavywa kula Chiajemi kpwa njira ya Chiswahili.
